name: SenPrints Integration for WooCommerce
author: SenPrints

sections.description:
The SenPrints Integration plugin connects your WooCommerce store to SenPrints’ print-on-demand fulfillment services. Automate your order fulfillment process and manage your print-on-demand products efficiently.

Key Features

  • One-click connection to SenPrints
  • Automatic order synchronization
  • Real-time order status updates
  • Auto-fulfill capability for hands-free operation
  • Dashboard widget for quick status overview
  • Detailed logging for troubleshooting
  • Manual order synchronization options

Third-Party Services

This plugin integrates with SenPrints’ print-on-demand fulfillment services and requires an active connection to SenPrints’ API servers to function. Here’s what you need to know about data transmission:

  • The plugin sends order data to SenPrints’ servers for processing and fulfillment
  • Order status updates are retrieved from SenPrints’ servers
  • Store authentication and verification are handled through SenPrints’ API
  • All data transmission is secured via SSL/TLS encryption

For more information about SenPrints’ services:
* Service Website: https://senprints.com
* Terms of Service: https://senprints.com/page/terms-of-service
* Privacy Policy: https://senprints.com/page/privacy

Requirements

  • WordPress 6.6 or higher
  • WooCommerce 8.9.3 or higher
  • PHP 8.1.0 or higher
  • SenPrints seller account

Support

For support, please visit seller.senprints.com or contact our customer service team.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/senprints directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Go to WooCommerce > Settings > Integration > SenPrints.
  4. Click the “Connect with SenPrints” button and log in to your SenPrints seller account.
  5. Enable Auto-Fulfill if desired.
sections.faq:
How do I connect my store to SenPrints?

Simply go to WooCommerce > Settings > Integration > SenPrints and click the “Connect with SenPrints” button. Log in to your SenPrints seller account when prompted, and your store will be automatically connected.

Don’t have a SenPrints seller account?

Visit seller.senprints.com to create your account. Once you have an account, return to your WordPress dashboard to complete the connection.

How does auto-fulfillment work?

When auto-fulfillment is enabled, orders containing SenPrints products will automatically be sent to SenPrints for processing once payment is received.

What happens if an order fails to sync?

Failed orders are automatically added to a retry queue and will be attempted again. You can also manually sync orders from the WooCommerce orders screen.
